title: Geometries for Small-Number Suppression — geom_suppress
code: geom_point_suppressed(   mapping = NULL,   data = NULL,   position = "identity",   ...,   threshold = 11,   proxy_value = 0,   na.rm = FALSE,   show.legend = NA,   inherit.aes = TRUE )  geom_col_suppressed(   mapping = NULL,   data = NULL,   position = "stack",   ...,   threshold = 11,   proxy_value = 0,   na.rm = FALSE,   show.legend = NA,   inherit.aes = TRUE )  geom_line_suppressed(   mapping = NULL,   data = NULL,   position = "identity",   ...,   threshold = 11,   proxy_value = 0,   na.rm = FALSE,   show.legend = NA,   inherit.aes = TRUE )

title: Geometries for Small-Number Suppression — geom_suppress
text: mapping Set aesthetic mappings created aes(). data data displayed layer. position Position adjustment. ... arguments passed layer(). threshold Numeric. Values threshold suppressed. Defaults 11. proxy_value Numeric. y-value suppressed data plotted. Defaults 0. na.rm FALSE, default, missing values removed warning. TRUE, missing values silently removed. show.legend logical. layer included legends? NA, default, includes aesthetics mapped. FALSE never includes, TRUE always includes. can also named logical vector finely select aesthetics display. include legend keys levels, even data exists, use TRUE. NA, levels shown legend, unobserved levels omitted. inherit.aes FALSE, overrides default aesthetics, rather combining . useful helper functions define data aesthetics inherit behaviour default plot specification, e.g. annotation_borders().
